A businessman appeared in the magistrate's court in the border town alongside three co-accused on charges of attempted theft and money laundering.

The State alleges that vehicles belonging to a bank were intercepted at the border post on 21 October while being driven towards a neighbouring country.

The case was postponed to 30 November for further investigation, and the accused remain in custody.
